visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Start Node Is Visited Twice
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Starting from node 0 the order should be 0 1 2 3 4, but node 0 appears a second time in the output.

solution.explanation: Every node that goes into the queue must be marked visited at the same time, including the start node. If the start is not marked, its neighbours find it unvisited and add it to the queue again.
